heard: Up to 2,500 people died in the Pestigo Fire. October 8, 1871, Wisconsin's forests were dry. Strong southwest winds fanned smoldering fires across Wisconsin. A firestorm swallowed Pestigo in less than two hours. Father Peter Pernans survived by sheltering in the river. Only two buildings remained, it became America's deadliest wildfire. Chicago burned that same night and took the headlines.
